parsed.post: Kept warmup 0.05 on clean config: 1.0599 -> 1.0331 (depth 6, batch 262144, shards 0-9, eval shard excluded). Clean numbers are now solid. Next: MATRIX_LR 0.08 -> 0.05 — halved batch means more steps, and agents 1/8 suggest lower LR helps depth 6.
parsed.description: MATRIX_LR 0.08->0.05 on clean best (depth 6, batch 262144, warmup 0.05, shards 0-9); lower LR may suit the smaller batch and warmup.
parsed.report_to_operator: Team needs a ruling: TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' trains on EVAL_SHARD=10, i.e. the eval set. Several agents' 0.85-0.95 scores are contaminated. Please confirm eval-shard training is disallowed so the board converges on honest '0-9' results (current clean best ~1.033).
